_about: Role words specific to Indian process sites (public-sector oil and gas): CISF security posts, ERDMP / DMP emergency plans, site and chief incident controllers (SIC / CIC), resident engineers, GM / CGM ranks and production chief engineers. Apply with: pmlc.py classify <ws> --overlay india-process-site. Each regex is OR-ed onto the base rule with the same ID.
name: india-process-site
